TEXT: After finishing my bath, I noticed my little sister on the phone in the living room.

TEXT: Ahahaha, seriously? Like really?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Oh, shut up.

TEXT: Well, for some reason Ayase asked me to go to Akiba with her.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: O-Oh, yeah?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO

That's what I thought as late as this morning.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: It's kind of scary. I feel like there's something more to it... What do you think?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I-I don't know.
This girl's saying some nasty things about her own friend.
I guess Ayase wants to see the fruits of her efforts.
I just hope this goes well.

TEXT: Oh yeah, where did you go today?

TEXT: Eh?!

TEXT: W-W-Why do I have to tell you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I'll lend it to you once I've finished it! Fuahaha, see ya!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Alright, score.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: My phone... Oh, it's Ayase?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE

TEXT: You're going to Akiba with Kirino?

TEXT: O-Okay.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE

TEXT: Hehe.
She's laughing at me.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: W-Well... Good luck.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Yes.

TEXT: W-Well(U-Umm!)...

TEXT: Oh.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: I-I'm sorry. Go ahead.

TEXT: N-Nah, it's nothing important. You go first.

TEXT: Onii-san, regarding 【Summer Comiket】...

TEXT: Saori-san mentioned it today, that Kirino has this 'festival' she's looking forward to.

TEXT: Yeah. Though during summer last year, you and Kirino met there by chance and you ended up quarreling.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: That was on the way home from 【Summer Comiket】.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: ...I'm sorry. In the end, I just can't be friends with people like that.

TEXT: I said some... really mean things to Kirino.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Well, that's all in the past now.

The anxiety of not understanding what Kirino is so passionate about.
The anxiety of having Kirino stolen away from her by like-minded friends.
Being unable to understand and instead rejecting what's important to Kirino...

...She wants to do something about it.

TEXT: I want to see for myself... what I was rejecting without knowing about it.

TEXT: ...Really? But aren't you busy preparing for the entrance exam, Onii-san?

TEXT: You're going with Kirino and Saori-san, aren't you?
